scope: A SchemaEditor external data generation during node modal closing

precise_component_regression.environment: Real React/AntD/dialog/rc-motion in jsdom; explicit animationend events, not browser or production-route reproduction

root Apply then external data during leave-active

browser_regression.scope_limit: Existing browser cases verify ordinary lifecycle, API success/denial, immediate DB and refresh, full interface unmount; do not claim same-instance external data motion reproduced in browser.

production_reachability: InterfaceEditForm passes state req_body_other/res_body through preserveFormatting normalization and receives local Apply text. Specific production external-replacement-during-close route was not demonstrated; this closes the reusable component external-data contract.
